crossRefs.note: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
For Herod had arrested John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother…
For John said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

people.name: Herodias
people.line: Wife of Herod Antipas who had John beheaded.

people.name: Philip
people.line: Herod Antipas' brother, first husband of Herodias
